description: Synthetic Bee conversation for the key-free run. Nobody said these words; it stands in for a real recording so the pipeline can be studied without an account.

transcript: Speaker 1: I showed Pocket Cinema to two people this morning and both of them scrolled past the hero looking for where they left off.
Speaker 2: So a Continue Watching rail, first thing on the home screen?
Speaker 1: Yes, at the top, above New this week. Four titles is plenty.
Speaker 2: Fine. The other thing that came up twice was runtime — on the details screen there is no way to tell if something is ninety minutes or three hours.
Speaker 1: Right, put the runtime next to the genre and the year on details. Minutes is fine, nobody needs hours and minutes.
Speaker 2: I'll be late tomorrow, my flight lands at six.
Speaker 1: No problem. Also my sister is visiting this weekend so I'm offline Saturday.
Speaker 2: Noted. Let's ship the rail and the runtime and look at search after that.
Speaker 1: Search can wait, we haven't agreed what it searches.
